result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback: any commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days’ notice, reconciled through a true-up rather than take-or-pay or penalty, and subordinate to Section 9.4 termination rights. It changes only Section 2.1 and preserves unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because Section 12.3 still states that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, creating tension with Section 2.1’s contemplated commitment, and the phrase “true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” does not clearly explain what amount is being reconciled.
